notes: Medium: the agent must build a pipeline that (1) fetches calendars over HTTP from a live schedule service with token auth so the result is fresh (not static), (2) drives a provided overlap tool subprocess on varied CSVs, and (3) implements a stateful validate-and-transfer rule with exact balance/ownership/log side effects. Hidden cases exercise an empty-overlap dataset, malformed CSV rows to skip, an empty-calendar person, and rejected (invalid-party / non-positive-amount) transfers, demanding generalized (not hard-coded) behavior; the multi-stage pipeline and exact byte-level freshness semantics add difficulty.
